title: Executor
description: A person appointed to administer an estate. Includes professional executors, administrators (intestacy), and administrators with will annexed

id.description: Unique identifier for this executor appointment within the INHERIT document

personId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the appointed executor or administrator

personIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced person

role.description: The executor's role in the estate administration
role.$comment: primary: the first-named executor who acts unless unable or unwilling. secondary: acts alongside the primary executor or takes over if the primary cannot act. substitute: named as a replacement if the primary and secondary cannot act. administrator: appointed by the court when there is no will (intestacy). administrator_with_will_annexed: appointed by the court when the will exists but the named executor cannot or will not act. literary: appointed to manage literary works, manuscripts, and intellectual property. digital: appointed to manage digital assets, online accounts, and cryptocurrency. specialist: appointed for a specific category of assets defined by the scope property.

isProfessional.description: Whether this executor is a professional (solicitor, accountant, trust corporation). Professional executors typically charge fees

firmName.description: Name of the professional firm, if the executor is acting in a professional capacity

grantType.description: The type of grant issued by the court authorising this person to act. Includes territory-neutral alternatives for non-Commonwealth jurisdictions
grantType.$comment: grant_of_probate: E&W/AU/NZ — court confirms the executor named in the will. letters_of_administration: E&W — court appoints an administrator when there is no will. letters_of_administration_with_will_annexed: E&W — court appoints an administrator when the named executor cannot act. succession_certificate: IN/PK — Indian Succession Act s.372, entitles holder to collect assets. certificate_of_inheritance: DE (Erbschein), JP (相続証明書), FR (Acte de notoriété) — certifies inheritance rights. court_appointment: generic court appointment of administrator (various jurisdictions). resealing: a foreign grant is recognised by a local court (common in Commonwealth jurisdictions). european_certificate_of_succession: EU document proving an heir's or executor's status under the Brussels IV Regulation.

grantReference.description: Court reference number for the grant

issuingCourt.description: Name of the court or registry that issued the grant

notes.description: Free-text notes about this executor appointment — reservations, renunciations, or special circumstances
examples: Power reserved to the secondary executor
Executor renounced — administrator with will annexed appointed

organisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id if the executor is a trust corporation or professional firm acting as executor. Mutually exclusive with personId

organisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation

primary.description: Whether this is the primary (lead) executor. Only one executor per estate should be marked as primary

consultWith.description: Person IDs of individuals the executor should consult before making significant decisions. Models co-equal authority and consultation requirements

scope.description: The scope of this executor's authority, for specialist executors. If absent, the executor has authority over the entire estate
scope.$comment: Use for literary executors (manuscripts, IP), digital executors (online accounts, crypto), or any executor appointed for specific asset categories only

examples: Digital assets and online accounts only
Literary works, manuscripts, and intellectual property

assetIds.description: Specific asset IDs this executor manages

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

conflictsOfInterest.description: Declared conflicts of interest — executor/trustee who is also a beneficiary, drafter, or family member
